name: Šaštín-Stráže (Slovakia)
description: Nine equal horizontal stripes of white, yellow, green, green, white, green, green, yellow and white, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature S-358/2006.
